title: Fix withLock wrapping errors from the locked callback
description: withLock (scripts/lib/lock.ts) catches every error thrown by its callback and rethrows non-BoardErrors as BoardError('Cannot lock <root>: …'). A disk error inside a write gets a misleading message, the bridge answers 400 invalid instead of 500 io_error, and the CLI exit reason is wrong. See HANDOVER §3.1.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Only errors from acquiring/releasing the lock are wrapped; errors from fn() propagate unchanged
Test: a non-BoardError thrown inside withLock reaches the caller unchanged; bridge answers 500 io_error
Unused imports (EXCLUSIVE, suffix) removed from lock.ts

notes: Fixed 2026-10-31. lock.ts split into acquire() (wrapped as 'Cannot lock') and fn() (propagates unchanged). If fn throws, a release failure is swallowed so it cannot mask it; if fn succeeds, a release failure is a lock error. Also fixed a double close of the lock fd on Windows acquire failure. lock.ts rewritten readable (HANDOVER §3.5 for this file). New tests: lock.test.ts (callback errors pass through; acquire failures wrapped) and bridge.test.ts (read-only item -> bridge 500 io_error, CLI exit 1). bun test: 63 pass, 0 fail. POSIX branch of the bridge test not yet run.
